title: ophryosporus peruvianus
intro: Ophryosporus peruvianus, commonly known as Peruvian Firecracker, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its vibrant red flowers and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Ophryosporus peruvianus include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which have been shown to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
